stem: 5. Find the symmetric difference between the following sets.

entries.question: (i) P = {2, 3, 5, 7, 11} and Q={1, 3, 5, 11}
steps: List the elements of P = {2, 3, 5, 7, 11} and Q = {1, 3, 5, 11}.
Keep elements that occur in exactly one set: (P−Q)∪(Q−P) = {1, 2, 7}.
Check each answer element occurs in one set, but not both; no common element is included.
entries.mathCheck: independent finite-set symmetric-difference enumeration; intersection exclusion

entries.question: (ii) R = {l, m, n, o, p} and S={j, l, n, q}
steps: List the elements of R = {l, m, n, o, p} and S = {j, l, n, q}.
Find the common elements: R∩S = {l, n}.
Keep elements that occur in exactly one set: (R−S)∪(S−R) = {j, m, o, p, q}.
Check each answer element occurs in one set, but not both; no common element is included.
entries.mathCheck: independent finite-set symmetric-difference enumeration; intersection exclusion

entries.question: (iii) X = {5, 6, 7} and Y={5, 7, 9, 10}
steps: List the elements of X = {5, 6, 7} and Y = {5, 7, 9, 10}.
Keep elements that occur in exactly one set: (X−Y)∪(Y−X) = {6, 9, 10}.
Check each answer element occurs in one set, but not both; no common element is included.
